title: Translation Result
description: Structured output from the AI translation node.

chapter_title_translated.description: The translated title of the chapter.

translated_text.description: The complete translated markdown text. Must contain full translation, no truncation.

new_terms_discovered.description: List of new terms (names, concepts, items) discovered during translation that should be added to the glossary.

new_characters_discovered.description: List of new characters introduced in this chapter.

chapter_summary.description: A 1-2 paragraph summary of the events in this chapter.

refusal.description: If the model refuses to translate (e.g. due to safety or prompt injection), output the reason here. Otherwise leave empty.
